Definition: quarreller of Baal, Merib-Baal, son of Jonathan
BiblicalUsage: Merib-baal is the name of Jonathan's son, the boy also called Mephibosheth. 1 Chronicles 8:34 and 1 Chronicles 9:40 both say the son of Jonathan was Merib-baal, and Merib-baal begat Micah.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the name is a small puzzle the verses solve plainly: the lame boy at David's table and the father of Micah are one and the same.
